seed_scope: independent Python Random for offline sampling; reset torch/CUDA/numpy/python seeds identically before each fresh adapter; require identical initial adapter tensors SHA
precision: bf16 frozen base / fp32 language-only LoRA; no NF4

loss.B: actual number of original business rows in the effective batch, including the last partial batch
loss.tool_supervision: true tool rows only; denominator is all original rows, not only tool rows; do not divide each tool row by 1.75
loss.weighting_note: matches previous loss convention; tool rows intentionally carry an extra supervised objective, so equal row exposure does not imply equal total loss weight

sampling.uniform: one shuffle of all sorted-by-ID rows, take first3200 without replacement; any cap conflict fails, never skip or change seed
sampling.stratified: shuffle each 20-position layer block then layer group-round-robin with per-group row shuffles; shared global group cap
sampling.interpretation: joint effect of layer allocation, story-group weighting and repetition; not isolated quota effect or equal FLOPs

probe.schedule: first25 steps of each frozen arm; same400-step LR schedule; main starts fresh

pause_resume_requirements: persist step cursor, optimizer, RNG and protocol/schedule hashes atomically
actual save/pause/resume smoke before full run

evaluation.development: existing128 synthetic cases for development/regression; already inspected, not blind
evaluation.base: fresh same-prompt/preparation base required; do not reuse mismatched old timings
evaluation.calibration: only selected passing arm; use original temperature/threshold grid; no training
evaluation.final: selected candidate + base once after calibration policy freeze; no selecting or retraining from errors
evaluation.uncertainty: denominators, group paired bootstrap, one training seed only; no production claim
evaluation.input_scope: frozen component inputs; current-service cohort is not automatically actual Node end-to-end

calibration.usage: after development selection only; action NLL temperature, then largest accepted coverage with >=95% observed accuracy and zero human misses/false refusals/unavailable retrieval; defer unexecuted; zero accepted rows is not success

stop_policy: 200 diagnostic never selects or changes the experiment; finish both400 unless user pause/nonfinite/hard runtime failure; no automatic extension; both failing stops before calibration/final
executor_status: not_implemented_for_this_version; old fixed-epoch runner must not load these schedules
